note: Candidates from the 2026-08-30 verify pass on the 43 ICNF register trees within 20km of Coimbra centre (data/research/coimbra-register-candidates.json and the fuller list in the brief). 4 trees verified to data/research/coimbra-verified.json (cbr_001-cbr_004): the botanical garden's bunya pine, the Karri Knight and Bunya Knight of Vale de Canas, and the ESAC camphor tree. Time-boxed to the close-in cluster (under 4km); everything past that, and one close candidate blocked on an access question, is here.

leads.name: Choupo-negro de Requeixadas
leads.why: ICNF register (processo KNJ1/216): girth 6.2m, height 20m, crown 15m, age_register 104 as measured in 2006 (so roughly 124 by 2026). Independently, a 2009 compilation blog (venerablesarboles.blogspot.com, 'Arvores Monumentais de Coimbra, Portugal') lists a Choupo/Populus nigra at Sao Martinho do Bispo with circumference 5m, height 22m, age 90, which is a plausible earlier-vintage snapshot of the same tree (growth trajectory is consistent) rather than a fresh independent measurement, so treat the two-source bar as thin here. NOT SHIPPED THIS PASS on access: the register's 'lugar' is 'Quinta das Requeixadas', and a search found only 'Casa do Bispo / Quinta de Sao Martinho do Bispo', which is the historic estate now occupied by the ESAC campus, in the same freguesia. Whether 'Quinta das Requeixadas' is public ESAC ground, a separate private quinta, or something else could not be confirmed this pass. Resolve that before verifying further; do not assume it is open.
